name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
description: Direct financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year payable in three equal four-monthly installments to cultivable landholding farmer families.

almost_eligible_hints.land_holding_hectares: Holding exceeds 2.0 Ha. If this is ancestral or joint family land, a legal partition deed (वारस नोंद / 7/12 फेरफार) separating individual shares can bring you within the small farmer quota.
almost_eligible_hints.has_bank_account: An Aadhaar-seeded bank account is required. You can open an instant zero-balance Jan Dhan account at your nearest post office or nationalized bank branch.
almost_eligible_hints.has_aadhaar: Aadhaar authentication is mandatory. Visit the nearest Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra or CSC center to update biometrics.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
department: Women & Child Development Department, Govt of Maharashtra
description: Direct monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 transferred to bank accounts of eligible women aged 21–65 years in Maharashtra.

almost_eligible_hints.annual_income: Income limit is ₹2.5 Lakhs per family. If you hold a Yellow or Orange Ration Card (BPL/APL), income certificate requirements are waived.
almost_eligible_hints.age: Applicable strictly between 21 and 65 years. Beneficiaries turning 21 this year become eligible upon date of birth.
almost_eligible_hints.gender: This scheme is exclusively for women (married, widowed, divorced, or single).

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
department: Ministry of Rural Development / Rural Development Dept Maharashtra
description: Financial grant of ₹1.20 Lakhs (plain areas) to ₹1.30 Lakhs (hilly areas) for constructing a permanent pucca house with basic amenities.

almost_eligible_hints.owns_pucca_house: Ownership of an existing pucca (brick/concrete) house disqualifies the household. Kutcha house owners or homeless citizens qualify with Gram Sabha verification.
almost_eligible_hints.annual_income: Income ceiling applies. Verify family SECC (Socio-Economic and Caste Census) listing with the Gram Sevak.

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
department: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Maharashtra
description: Additional top-up assistance of ₹6,000 per year by Maharashtra Government for farmers already receiving PM-KISAN (Total ₹12,000/year).

almost_eligible_hints.occupation: Beneficiary must be an active landholder registered with Maharashtra agricultural records (MahaDBT / 7/12 portal).
almost_eligible_hints.land_holding_hectares: Must qualify as small/marginal farmer under the same criteria as PM-KISAN.

name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana
department: Social Justice & Special Assistance Dept, Govt of Maharashtra
description: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 for destitute persons, elderly, disabled, widows, and persons with major illnesses having no income source.

almost_eligible_hints.annual_income: Statutory annual family income ceiling is ₹21,000. A formal Tahsildar destitute certificate (निराधार दाखला) is required.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) / MoF
description: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60 depending on monthly contributions for unorganized sector workers.

almost_eligible_hints.age: Enrollment is capped between 18 and 40 years. If over 40, explore PM Shram Yogi Maandhan or NPS-Lite schemes.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) 2.0
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Govt of India
description: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection with stove and first refill provided free to adult women of poor households.

almost_eligible_hints.gender: LPG connection under Ujjwala is exclusively issued in the name of an adult female member of the household.
almost_eligible_hints.age: Applicant woman must be at least 18 years old and no other LPG connection should exist in the same household.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Shetkari Karjmukti Yojana
department: Co-operation, Marketing and Textiles Dept, Govt of Maharashtra
description: Debt waiver and incentive relief up to ₹50,000 for farmers in Maharashtra who regularly repay their crop loans.

almost_eligible_hints.occupation: Applicant must have an active agricultural crop loan account (Kisan Credit Card / PACS loan) linked to Aadhaar.
